hypothesis: Can separate deny-by-default adapters turn only human-visible messages from Codex, Claude Code and locally cached ChatGPT conversations into one normalized private library without admitting tool calls, tool results, thinking, files, logs or credentials?

allowed_records: locally cached conversation node with author role user or assistant and text parts
chatgpt_desktop.honest_boundary: The adapter reads only data actually cached on the device. It does not promise complete cloud history and does not accept an export or arbitrary user-selected JSON file. Unknown local formats stay blocked until their structure is inspected and frozen.

claim_boundary: Fixture success does not validate an app adapter on a real device. Each detected real storage format must pass a count-and-spot-check checkpoint before joining the MVP library.
